47394ee9954232da.title: An Evening with MIKE MASSÉ
47394ee9954232da.desc: MIKE MASSÉ is an internationally acclaimed artist delivering epic acoustic performances of classic rock favorites. A YouTube sensation with over 200 million vies, Massé has earned praise from the very legends whose songs he reimagines- Toto calls his acoustic version of "Africa" their favorite (with over 20 millions views on YouTube.) From the Beatles and Billy Joel to Elton John, Simon & Garfunkel, and Dan Fogelberg, Massé transforms beloved songs into powerful, intimate live experiences- performances that are true to the original- yet refreshingly original. What began as viral YouTube performances has evolved into a must-see live show, with arrangements known for their precision, creativity, and emotional impact- staying faithful to the spirit of the originals while showcasing his own distinctive voice. Touring across the U.S. and internationally, Massé invites audiences to experience his signature sound live- on a mission to "cover the music, cover the world." Everyone entering the theatre must have a ticket regardless of age or seating requirements. All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges.
